name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 39 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2025-05-12, at wavelengths from 1.33 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
